records.original_evidence: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi.  Tibiofemoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, ödem ve dejeneratif milimetrik kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı. Medial menisküs diz ekleminden tamamı ile 6 mm mediale ekstrudedir. Menisküs hacminde azalma, menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve kompleks yırtıklar izlenmektedir. Lateral menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 5 mm laterale ekstrudedir.  Menisküs posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlendi. Anterior hornda grade III dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Anterior çapraz bağın belirgin  olarak incelmiş olduğu ve sinyalinde PD imajlarda artış olduğu izlenmektedir. Arka çapraz bağ ve lateral kollateral ligamen normaldir. Medial kollateral ligamande periligamentöz ödem izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem lateralde periartiküler büyüğü 7 mm çaplı loose body formasyonları izlendi. Tibiofibular eklem aralığı daralmış, ekleme komşu tibia lateral plato ve fibula başında subkondrial kistler izlendi. Popliteal fossada 7x2 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlendi.Prepatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Sonuç: Gonartroz.Medial ve lateral meniskürde eklem mesafesinden ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı, grade III  dejenerasyon ve kompleks yırtıklar. Anterior çapraz bağda komplete yakın geniş yırtık. Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Suprapatellar bursit.  Diz ekleminde sinovit. Tibiofibular eklemde artroz.Tibiofemoral eklem anteriorunda periartiküler loose body formasyonları.  Popliteal fossada baker kisti.Patellada subkondrial kemik iliği ödemleri.

records.original_evidence:
No significant knee effusion, there are no intra-articular bodies either.  
Multilocular cystic mass posterior to the posterior cruciate ligament, deep to the popliteal neurovascular bundle, in keeping with a ganglion cyst that is arising from the knee joint proper.
There is a complex, undisplaced tear through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
There is associated high signal within the subchondral bone of the lateral aspect of the medial tibial plateau, potentially representative of a bone marrow contusion. 
Any history of direct trauma to account for such appearances?
The lateral meniscus is intact, as are the cruciate and collateral ligaments, distal iliotibial band, popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons in the remaining marrow signal throughout.
High-riding patella noted, together with pre femoral fat pad impingement - any history of anterior knee pain?
Solitary grade 3 cartilage fissure noted at the medial retropatellar facet.
Tricompartmental articular cartilage is otherwise well preserved.  
Anterior subcutaneous edema like signal change with no discrete bursal formation, kindly correlate clinically.
Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues. 

Impression:
Complex undisplaced medial meniscal tear.
Focal medial retropatellar cartilage damage.
Multifactorial low grade extensor mechanism pathology.
Suspected posteromedial proximal tibial bone marrow contusion.

records.original_evidence:
FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion with synovitis. Large complex popliteal cyst measuring up to 65 mm with an 11 mm osseous body in the superior aspect of the cyst. Sliver of free fluid along the inferior margin of the popliteal cyst suggesting minimal recent partial rupture.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Moderate degenerative change.
Complex degenerative tear with a dominant longitudinal horizontal oblique component of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with inferior surfacing. Fraying and blunting of the meniscal free edge.
Mild thickening of the proximal MCL compatible with remote injury.
Diffuse low grade partial-thickness chondral loss. Marginal osteophytosis.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Severe degenerative change with full-thickness chondral loss of the weightbearing and posterior portion of the compartment, with subchondral reactive marrow change. Marginal osteophytosis.
Complex degenerative multidirectional tear of the posterior horn extending into the body with significant maceration and substance loss of the body and anterior and posterior horn with minimal residual meniscal substance. There is some extrusion of the body of the lateral meniscus.
Thickened popliteus insertion with intrasubstance signal compatible with moderate tendinosis
Mildly thickened lateral collateral ligament proper which could reflect the sequela of a remote injury. Mild distal biceps tendinosis.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Degenerative changes of the anterior cruciate ligament which remains intact. The PCL is intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Mild chondropathy. Small marginal osteophytes. Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis. Mild edema at the suprapatellar fat pad.
Scarring at that the Hoffa's fat pad which could reflect the previous surgery-for clinical correlation.

Bones:
See above.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
The intra-articular body is seen at the suprapatellar joint recess on the previous MRI is no longer present.

CONCLUSION:
1.Interval worsening of the severe osteoarthritis of the lateral compartment. Complex degenerative tearing and extensive maceration the lateral meniscus.
2.Moderate degenerative change of the medial compartment. Complex degenerative tear with a dominant longitudinal oblique tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus.
3.Mild degenerative change of the patellofemoral compartment.
4.Large complex popliteal cyst with an osseous body.

records.original_evidence:
LEFT KNEE MRI 

CLINICAL INDICATION: Medial meniscus injury, query MCL tear

Technique: Multiplanar PD, PF fat sat and T1 imaging was acquired through the knee. 

Comparison: The x-ray [Date]

Findings:

General:
Marrow:  There is edema of the medial femoral condyle at the site of the MCL insertion, and in the posterolateral femoral condyle. There is edema in the medial proximal tibia and the posterolateral proximal tibia.
Consistent with internal bone contusion secondary valgus injury.
Effusion:  No significant effusion

Menisci:   
Medial meniscus:   Intact.
Lateral meniscus:   Intact.

Ligaments and tendons:
Cruciate ligaments:   There is increased signal in the PCL, which may be keeping with a low-grade tear. No tibial translation.
Medial collateral ligament:   High-grade partial-thickness tear of the proximal of the mid fibers of the superficial medial collateral ligament. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the meniscal femoral as well as posterior plate components of the deep medial collateral ligament.
Lateral collateral ligament:   normal
Popliteofibular ligament:   normal
Other posterolateral corner ligaments:   normal
Popliteal tendon:   normal
Iliotibial band:   normal

Extensor mechanism:
Quadriceps tendon: Mild increased signal along the patellar insertion, in keeping with tendinosis
Patella:   normal

Lateral menisküs gövdesi düzeyinde serbest kenar düzensizliği bu düzeydeki püsküllenme tarzında yırtık açısından şüpheli. İç yan bağın femoral insersiyona yakın kesimdeki intraoseöz gangliyon kisti 1 cm çapında. Patellofemoral eklem dejenerasyonu patella apeksi ve çevresindeki troklear kıkırdağın santralindeki kondral kalınlığın %50'sine ulaşan incelme ve milimetrik çaplı subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklikler ile karakterize. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal). Distal uyluk ve proksimal baldır kasları en belirgin gastrokinemyus kasının medyal ve  lateral başında olmak üzere atrofik.

records.original_evidence:
Constatations:

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré, avec suspicion d'un niveau graisseux au versant externe suggérant un degré de lipohémarthrose. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du creux poplité et de la portion supérieure de la patte d'oie. 

Il y a un émoussement du rebord postérieur de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suspect d'une déchirure longitudinale verticale périphérique potentielle. Il y a également une extrusion relativement significative du corps méniscal, le plus probablement en lien avec une déchirure complète du ligament collatéral interne. 

Il y a une déchirure complète du ligament colléral interne distal avec rétraction proximale des fibres déchirées, associées à de multiples zones d'irrégularités, épaississements et signal anormal intra-substance. Il y également une atténuation et signal intra-substance à son origine. La partie distale du ligament collatéral interne déchirée se situe légèrement sous les tendons de la patte d'oie constituant une lésion de type ''pseudo Stener''. Il y a également une déchire complète de la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale et une déchirure partielle de la composante ménisco-tibiale. 

Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante fémorotibiale interne.

Le ménisque externe est intact sans déchirure. Il y a une petite fracture au versant supérieur de la tête du péroné potentiellement à l'insertion du ligament poplité arqué. Minime déplacement et œdème associés. L'insertion distale du ligament collatéral externe et du tendon du biceps est préservé de même que l'origine. Il y a également une petite ossification au versant postérieur de la tête du péroné mesurant 5 mm, d'origine indéterminée. 

Il y a des irrégularités de l'os sous-chondral à la surface portante du condyle fémoral externe d'allure plutôt chronique. Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante fémorotibiale externe. Toutefois, petit foyer d'œdème au versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe avec léger hypersignal chondral, contusion versus lésion oséto-chondrale (atypique) versus changement de stress en lien avec l’origine du gastrocnémien externe. 

Kyste ganglionnaire à l'origine des deux gastrocnémiens.

Il y a une déchirure d'allure complète à l'insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur et/ou avulsion du LCP. Le ligament est rétracté proximalement, épaissi et de signal anormal. Il y a une atténuation significative du ligament croisé antérieur sans composante transfixiante toutefois notée, en lien avec une déchirure partielle. Il y a des contusions probablement associées au plateau tibial externe, plus marquées en postérieur +/- impaction/fracture sous-chondrale.

Petit kyste ganglionnaire à l'empreinte distale du ligament croisé antérieur.

L'alignement patello-fémoral demeure dans les limites normales. Séquelles de maladie Osgood Schlatter avec fragmentation d'allure chronique de la tubérosité tibiale et léger épaississement du tendon rotulien. Le tendon du quadriceps distal est intact sans déchirure. Pas d'atteinte chondrale transfixiante patello-fémorale. La graisse de Hoffa est sans grande particularité.

Il y a un œdème diffus significatif sous-cutané et inter-musculaire. Il y a également un œdème des muscles poplité et plantaire en lien avec une entorse.

Conclusion:

Déchirure complète du ligament collatéral interne distal avec déplacement de la portion distale sous les tendons de la patte d'oie en lien avec une lésion de type 'pseudo Stener''. Il y a également une déchirure complète de la composante profonde ménisco-fémorale et partielle de la composante ménisco-tibiale.

Déchirure d'allure complète du ligament croisé postérieur distal et/ou avulsion du LCP. Déchirure partielle probable du ligament croisé antérieur.

Fracture au versant supérieur de la tête du péroné probablement à l'insertion du ligament poplité arqué. Œdème associé.

De plus, contusions probable du plateau tibial externe +/- impaction/fracture sous-chondrale et du versant postérieur du condyle fémoral externe. 

Émoussement du rebord postérieur de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne suspect d'une déchirure longitudinale verticale périphérique potentielle.

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré avec composante de lipohémarthrose suspectée.

Dans ce contexte, un complément d'investigation par tomodensitométrie est recommandé pour mieux évaluer les structures osseuses. De plus, une consultation en chirurgie orthopédique est également, fortement recommandée. 

Le rapport a été transcrit en priorité.

records.original_evidence:
MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


> Osteophytes and irregular thining intra-articular cartilage of left knee, reflecting osteoarthritis; Subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts of medial femoral condyle
> Severe wearing of medial facet cartilage of patella, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia; patellar osteophytes
  Severe wearing of medial femoral trochlea with subchondral edema, reeflecting grade 4 chondromalacia.
> Patellar enthesophyte and tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. Retrocondylar bursitis; popliteal bursitis
> Linear signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
  Increased singal intensity of meniscocapsular junction posterior horn of medial meniscus
> The contour of ACL in a straight line and increase interstitial signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of mucoid degeneration.
> Mild interstitial increased signal of PCL and lateral patellar retinaculum, in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneraiton.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, R/O Anserine bursitis
> Subcutanoeus edema over left knee
> In favor of focal fatty muscle transformation of gastrocnemius muscle. Mild muscle edema also noted.
> Some varicose veins.
Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee, more severe at meidal compartment of left knee and grade 4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint and 3-4 chondromalacia of medial femorotibial joint.
2. Synovitis of left knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae; prominent retrocondylar bursitis and popliteal bursitis. 
3. Anserine bursitis.
4. Degeneration of meniscus and R/O Ramp lesion over meniscocapsular junction of posteiror horn of medial meniscus.
5. In favor of mucoid degeneration of ACL.R/O grade 1 injury or degeneraiton of PCL and lateral patellar retinaculum.
6. Subcutanoeus edema over left knee.Some varicose veins.
7. Mild subcutanoeus edmea and muscle edema over left knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

records.original_evidence:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Subluxación patelar. Meniscopatía medial.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Amputación marginal del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Rotura compleja con componente principal longitudinal del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y cuerno
posterior del menisco medial con segmento desplazado en "asa de balde" a la región
intercondílea. El remanente a nivel del cuerpo y cuerno posterior también presenta una rotura
horizontal oblicua contacta la superficie articular inferior de manera periférica con mínimo edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial medial de manera reactiva.
Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total lineales de la región central del platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales. Úlcera condral de espesor total
de la región central de la tróclea femoral con cambios óseos secundarios. Úlceras condrales de
espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano de distribución difusa.
Moderado derrame articular. Quiste poplíteo con signos de rotura con líquido perifascial hacia
cefálico y caudal.
Leve aumento de señal en inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento desplazado en "asa de balde". Rotura del
remanente a nivel del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial, periférica. Discreto edema
óseo periférico del platillo tibial de manera reactiva.
Rotación marginal del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral.
Condropatía lesiones focales grado 4 de la región central del platillo tibial lateral. Condropatía
superficial del resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía con lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la
rótula.
Moderado derrame articular. Quiste poplíteo con signos de rotura.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal

EYΡΗΜΑΤΑ - Χωρίς αξιόλογη ενδαρθρική συλλογή υγρού. - Αναγνωρίζονται έντονες εκφυλιστικές αλλοιώσεις στο έσω µεσάρθριο µε ολικού πάχους απώλεια του αντικείµενου αρθρικού χόνδρου, πλάγια επιχέιλια οστεόφυτα, στένωση του µεσάρθριου, υπαρθρικές κυστικές αλλοιώσεις και διαταραχή της αρχιτεκτονικής του µηνίσκου µε συνοδό υπεξάρθρηµα αυτού και παρουσία παραµηνισκικών κύστων εκατέρωθεν της πρόσθιας µοίρα του έσω πλαγίου συνδέσµου, συνολικών διαστάσεων 2.3 Χ 0.9 cm. Μικρότερης έκτασης εκφυλιστικές αλλοιώσεις αναδεικνύονται στο έξω µεσάρθριο µε µερικού πάχους απώλεια του αντικείµενου αρθρικού χονδρου, πλάγια επιχείλια οστεόφυτα. Επισηµαίνεται σηµαντική απώλεια µηνισκικής µάζας σώµατος µηνίσκου σύστοιχα µε πιθανή αναδίπλωση µηνισκικού υλικού στο επίπεδο του οπισθίου κέρατος. Οστεοπαραγωγικές διαδικασίες - οστεόφυτα αναδεικνύονται κεντρικά στην άρθρωση του γόνατος. Μικρός οζόµορφος επασβεστωµένος σχηµτισµός 6.6 mm αναγνωρίζεται στην οπίσθια µοίρα της άρθρωσης του γόνατος στο πλαίσιο αρχόµενης οστεοχονδρωµάτωσης. Μικρές συνοβιακές - γαγγλιακές κύστεις παρατηρούνται στην πρόσθια µοίρα του γόνατος µέγιστης συνολικής διαµέτρου ~1 cm. - Φυσιολογικά απεικονίζονται οι χιαστοί και πλάγιοι σύνδεσµοι. - Εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο λοιπός αρθρικός χόνδρος. - Με σήµα εντός του φυσιολογικού ελέγχεται ο λοιπός οστικός µυελός. - Χωρίς ευρήµατα δυσλειτουργίας του εκτατικού µηχανισµού.

records.original_evidence:
MRI of left knee with -Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Findings:
> The contour of anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments appearing within normal limit
> High signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus without significant extending to the surface, probably due to myxoid degeneration
> Bony fragement in posterior knee joint, suspecious of loose body.
> Spur formation in left knee joint and patella with subchondral edema and cysts, indicating osteoarthritis.
> Full thickness cartilage loss of patella, suggestive of chondromalacia
> Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Impression:
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee joint
2. Suspect intra-articular loose body in posterior knee joint
3. Myxoid degeneration of medial and lateral meniscus
4. Chondromalacia of patella cartilage
5. Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further evaluation.

records.original_evidence:
FINDINGS:

Fractures:
Known mildly comminuted undisplaced avulsion fracture of the tibial tuberosity involving the distal ACL insertion, anteriorly the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, as well as posteriorly the tibial insertion of both the posterior horn of medial and lateral menisci. The fracture involves the central portion of the medial tibial plateau articular surface anteriorly and posteriorly with articular surface collapse of 3 mm anteriorly and 5 mm posteriorly, as well as a step deformity of up to 2 mm posteriorly.
Small mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the lateral corner of lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
Small mild osteochondral impaction at the anterior lateral weightbearing aspect of lateral femoral condyle.
There is associated bone marrow edema associated with these fractures.

Joint alignment:
Mild widening of the medial femorotibial joint space. Otherwise preserved articular alignment.

Degenerative changes:
None.

Bone marrow signal:
Additional small area of bone marrow edema on the medial side of medial femoral condyle without evidence of associated fracture.

Anterior cruciate ligament: The distal bony avulsion with laxity of the ACL, showing some internal high T2 signal changes compatible with additional low-grade partial ligamentous tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Intact with mild laxity.
Medial collateral ligament: Complete tear of the superficial portion at the mid to distal third. Moderate grade partial tear of the deep meniscal femoral and meniscal tibial components with partial meniscocapsular separation of the medial meniscal body.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: Low-grade sprain of the proximal lateral collateral ligament. The other associated structures are intact.

Medial meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes of the meniscal body, with evidence of small horizontal oblique tear extending to the femoral surface. No other significant tear. Bony avulsion of the posterior horn root insertion as detailed above.
Lateral meniscus: Mild nonspecific signal changes at the anterior horn compatible with low-grade tearing. Evidence of small Wrisberg rip-type longitudinal tear of the periphery of the posterior horn. Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury. There is a bony avulsion of the anterior horn and posterior horn root insertion sites.

Extensor tendons: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Moderate grade partial tear of the medial retinaculum.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corner: Diffuse signal change and mild thickening of the distal semimembranosus tendon compatible with low to moderate grade partial tearing.
Complete tear of the inferior meniscal popliteal fascicle compatible with posterior lateral corner injury.

Joint effusion: Large joint effusion.
Baker cyst: None.

Other significant findings:
None.

CONCLUSION:
*Comminuted mildly displaced avulsion fracture of the tibial spine with mild comminution, including the distal insertion of the ACL, the anterior horn root insertion of the lateral meniscus, and posterior horn root insertion zone of the medial and lateral menisci. Intra-articular fracture extension involving the central portion of the medial tibial plateau with small gap/step as described.
*Small mildly displaced lateral corner fracture of the lateral tibial plateau [Segond fracture].
*Small osteochondral impaction fracture of the lateral corner of lateral femoral condyle.
*High-grade tear of the medial collateral ligament.
*Low-grade partial tear/sprain of the anterior cruciate ligament and lateral collateral ligament.
*Additional low-grade tears involving the medial and lateral menisci as described.
*Moderate grade partial tear of the medial patellar retinaculum.
*Posteromedial and posterolateral corner injuries as described.
*Large joint effusion.
